entities.name: Marc Crépon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marc Crépon  is a French philosopher and academic who writes on the subject of languages and communities in the French and German philosophies and contemporary political and moral philosophy. He has also translated works by philosophers such as Nietzsche, Franz Rosenzweig and Leibniz.
